title: Lumos signed configuration package
$comment: Envelope for a signed configuration package (TRS Sec. 13, TRS-CFG-001). Configuration may ONLY alter behaviour that is already implemented. It never carries executable content of any kind - no scripts, no HTML, no templates, no expressions (TRS-ARCH-006). The schema admits no free-form object anywhere, which is what makes that enforceable rather than merely stated. The overrides member is validated by config_overrides.schema.json, which is GENERATED from the constants register so its bounds cannot drift from TRS Sec. 23 (ADR-004).
x-fail-closed: An invalid, expired, rolled-back, wrong-environment or hash-mismatched package is REJECTED and the last-known-good package stays active. Never fail open, and never activate a partially valid package.

signature.$comment: Computed over the canonical encoding of payload. Production private signing keys live only in owner-controlled KMS/HSM (ADR-001, gate G-05); the agent never holds one.

version.$comment: Monotonic. A package whose version is not greater than the active one is rejected with ERR_CONFIG_ROLLBACK.

constants_hash.$comment: Must equal this build's register hash, else ERR_CONFIG_CONSTANTS_HASH_MISMATCH (TRS-CONST-005). This is what makes constant drift mechanically detectable.

overrides.$comment: GENERATED bounds. Only constants marked overridable appear, each with its register min/max; additionalProperties is false, so naming a frozen constant is rejected rather than ignored (TRS-CONST-002).

kill_switches.$comment: Feature disablement only. A kill switch may turn something OFF; it can never turn on a capability that is not already built, and it fails to the documented safe baseline (TRS-ARCH-010).

sponsor_assets.$comment: maxItems mirrors SPONSOR_ASSET_MAX_KB.cache_count. Assets are static images with alt text; alt text is required because sponsor content is subject to the same accessibility bar as the rest of the product (SRS-NFR-A11Y).
